notes: Makes the normal online document-reading workflow explicit for iPhone: Analyze with ChatGPT now copies the prepared TEE analysis request and opens ChatGPT directly. The in-app How do I do this instructions walk through attach same document → Paste → Send → Copy JSON → return to TEE → Paste Results → verify → Save to TEE Vault. Share-sheet availability is no longer required. Vault behavior and private data are unchanged.
